gate: Has a certificate (computer-assisted or analytic) for arXiv:2604.01868 section 6.2's Boussinesq_S2_nonsymmetric profile been published since the paper's own date?

gate_answer.statement: no certificate, computer-assisted or analytic, has appeared for the non-symmetric strictly-positive regular self-similar profile of the 2D Boussinesq equations (arXiv:2604.01868 section 6.2) as of 2026-08-06, 126 days after the paper's v1
gate_answer.known_weakness: every channel is an ABSENCE argument.  Unlike leg 77's rank-2 watch, whose decisive evidence was a POSITIVE act (the authors revised at 82 days and left the watched branch as numerics), this leg has no positive act to point at -- only 126 days of silence, the title's 'A Numerical Investigation', and line 2069's statement of intent.  That is weaker evidence than leg 77 had, and this watch should be re-asked on a SHORTER interval than the rank-2 one
gate_answer.ledger_consequence: target_selection.py's 'certified': 'NO' for Boussinesq_S2_nonsymmetric is CURRENT as of 2026-08-06, not stale -- bank the dated watch entry.  No edit required; the file was not touched (leg 63 owns it)
gate_answer.ledger_precision_suggestion: the entry's 'source' field cites the paper WITHOUT a version.  Only v1 exists as of this pass, so pinning it to '2604.01868v1' costs nothing and makes a future revision detectable by diff rather than by re-reading.  A bookkeeping nicety, not a correction
